about.storyTitle: Shaping Minds. Building Character. Inspiring Futures.
storyParagraphs: At Red Rose English Boarding School, we believe that education is the foundation for successful lives and responsible communities. Located in Hetauda-16, Hatiya, Makwanpur, our school provides a safe, inclusive, and inspiring environment where every child is encouraged to discover their potential, embrace challenges, and grow with confidence. Guided by our motto, “For Knowledge and Virtue,” we nurture not only academic excellence but also integrity, respect, creativity, leadership, and social responsibility.

Our approach goes beyond textbooks, combining strong academics with practical learning, technology, sports, arts, leadership, and extracurricular opportunities. Through dedicated teachers, personalized guidance, and strong collaboration among parents, school, and community, we support the intellectual, emotional, physical, and social development of every learner. We strive to develop critical thinking, communication, collaboration, resilience, and problem-solving skills while inspiring curiosity and lifelong learning. At Red Rose English Boarding School, we don't just educate students—we inspire lifelong learners, responsible citizens, and future leaders.

messages.name: Sarita Bhandari Dahal
messages.title: Dear Students, Parents, and Visitors,
messages.message:
Welcome to Red Rose English Boarding School, where learning is inspired by our commitment to "For Knowledge and Virtue." We believe that every child possesses unique talents and the potential to achieve excellence when provided with the right guidance, opportunities, and encouragement.
Our dedicated team of educators works tirelessly to create a safe, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment that promotes academic achievement, character development, creativity, and lifelong learning. We strive to prepare our students not only for examinations but also for the challenges and opportunities of the future.
At Red Rose English Boarding School, we value the strong partnership between students, parents, teachers, and the community. Together, we nurture confident, compassionate, and responsible individuals who are ready to make a positive difference in society.
Thank you for visiting our website. We invite you to become a part of our school family and join us in shaping a brighter future for every child.

messages.name: Madan Dahal
messages.title: Dear Students, Parents, and Well-Wishers,
messages.message:
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Red Rose English Boarding School. When this institution was established, the vision was simple yet profound—to provide quality education that nurtures both knowledge and character, empowering young minds to become responsible, confident, and compassionate citizens.
Education is not merely about academic success; it is about developing values, discipline, curiosity, and the courage to face life's challenges. At Red Rose English Boarding School, we are committed to creating an environment where every child is respected, inspired, and encouraged to discover their full potential.
The success of our school is the result of the unwavering dedication of our teachers, the trust of our parents, the hard work of our students, and the continued support of our community. Together, we have built a learning community that strives for excellence while remaining grounded in integrity, respect, and service.
As we continue this journey, we remain committed to preparing our students not only for academic achievement but also for meaningful lives as ethical leaders and lifelong learners.
Thank you for your trust and confidence in Red Rose English Boarding School. We look forward to continuing this journey of excellence together.

facilities.title: Spaces Built For How Students Actually Learn
facilities.subtitle: Red Rose Boarding School provides modern facilities that create an engaging, practical, and technology-driven learning environment for every student.
facilities.introTitle: Places that make learning feel real.
facilities.introDescription: Our campus is designed as more than a collection of rooms. Each space gives students an opportunity to read, experiment, create, perform, travel safely, stay active, and discover the confidence that comes from doing things for themselves.
facilities.sectionSubtitle: Explore the spaces and services that support the academic, creative, physical, and social development of our students.
facilities.approachDescription: Facilities are more than buildings and equipment—they are spaces where learning comes to life. We continually work to improve our learning environment and provide students with opportunities to learn through experience, technology, creativity, collaboration, and participation.

facilities.title: Modern Classrooms
facilities.description: Bright, comfortable, and learning-focused classrooms that support interactive teaching and active participation.
facilities.details: The classrooms provide a comfortable and supportive setting for everyday learning, encouraging students to participate actively, interact with lessons, and develop their understanding with confidence.

facilities.title: Computer & ICT Facilities
facilities.description: Technology-supported learning spaces that help students develop essential digital skills.
facilities.details: The computer and ICT facilities give students opportunities to use technology as part of their learning and build practical digital skills needed for study and everyday life.

facilities.title: Science Laboratory
facilities.description: Practical learning facilities where students can observe, experiment, and connect theoretical knowledge with real-world applications.
facilities.details: The science laboratory allows students to observe scientific processes, carry out experiments, and connect what they learn in class with practical and real-world applications.

facilities.title: Library & Reading Resources
facilities.description: A learning space that encourages reading, research, independent learning, and intellectual curiosity.
facilities.details: The library and reading resources provide students with a dedicated space to read, research, study independently, explore information, and develop intellectual curiosity.

facilities.title: Sports & Recreation
facilities.description: Facilities and spaces that encourage physical fitness, teamwork, discipline, and healthy competition.
facilities.details: Sports and recreation facilities encourage students to stay physically active while developing teamwork, discipline, cooperation, confidence, and a healthy sense of competition.

facilities.title: Creative & Cultural Activities
facilities.description: Opportunities and spaces for art, music, cultural activities, performances, and creative expression.
facilities.details: Students have opportunities to explore art, music, cultural activities, performances, and creative expression while discovering and developing their individual talents.

facilities.title: Multipurpose Spaces
facilities.description: Suitable spaces for assemblies, presentations, workshops, competitions, celebrations, and school events.
facilities.details: Multipurpose spaces provide flexible venues for assemblies, presentations, workshops, competitions, celebrations, and other activities that bring the school community together.

facilities.title: Transportation
facilities.description: School transportation designed to support convenient and organized student travel.
facilities.details: The school's transportation service is designed to support convenient and organized student travel and make daily journeys to and from school easier for students and families.

facilities.title: Safety & Security
facilities.description: A secure school environment with appropriate safety measures to ensure students can learn with confidence.
facilities.details: Safety and security are an important part of school life, with appropriate measures intended to provide students with a secure, supportive, and confident learning environment.

facilities.title: Clean & Hygienic Environment
facilities.description: Well-maintained facilities that promote cleanliness, hygiene, and student well-being.
facilities.details: A clean and hygienic environment helps maintain student wellbeing and provides comfortable, well-maintained spaces for learning and daily school activities.

facilities.title: Child-Friendly Environment
facilities.description: A safe, caring, welcoming, and supportive atmosphere where every child feels respected, valued, and comfortable expressing themselves.
facilities.details: The school aims to provide a safe and caring atmosphere where every child feels respected and valued and can express themselves comfortably and confidently.

facilities.title: Activity-Based Learning
facilities.description: Learning through activities, experiments, projects, games, discussions, and practical experiences to make education engaging and meaningful.
facilities.details: Activity-based learning allows students to learn through participation, experiments, projects, games, discussions, and practical experiences, making education more engaging and meaningful.

facilities.title: Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
facilities.description: Classroom practices that encourage students to ask questions, analyze situations, find solutions, and think independently.
facilities.details: Students are encouraged to ask questions, analyze situations, explore solutions, and think independently so they can approach challenges thoughtfully.

facilities.title: Collaborative Learning
facilities.description: Group activities and peer interaction that develop communication, cooperation, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
facilities.details: Collaborative learning gives students opportunities to work together, share ideas, communicate clearly, cooperate on tasks, and develop leadership and interpersonal skills.

facilities.title: Values-Based Education
facilities.description: Emphasis on discipline, responsibility, respect, kindness, honesty, and other values that contribute to responsible citizenship.
facilities.details: Values-based education emphasizes discipline, responsibility, respect, kindness, honesty, and other positive values that help students develop responsible and respectful character.

facilities.title: Presentation & Communication Opportunities
facilities.description: Activities that help students build confidence, communication skills, leadership, and public-speaking abilities.
facilities.details: Students receive opportunities to present ideas, communicate with others, build confidence, develop leadership skills, and become more comfortable with public speaking.
